source: 796 “Duel”
target: 796 “Certamen”

source: 796 “Duel”
target: 796 “Certamen”

source: In response to Albus’s question, Lumian let out a soft laugh and muttered to himself, This guy seems pretty sharp…
target: Ad quaestionem Albi respondens, Lumian leniter risit et sibi murmurat: “Hic vir videtur valde acutus…”

source: No idea when he was exiled to Morora, but this must be his first time eating here…
target: Nescio quo tempore in Mororam exsulatus sit, sed hoc videtur primum esse quo hic cibum sumat…

source: Did he come here because he noticed some people in Morora behaving strangely after eating at this bar?
target: Venitne hic quia animadvertit aliquos in Morora, postquam in hac taberna cibo usi sunt, se mirum modum gerere?

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian slapped the bar counter.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, Lumian mensam tabernae percussit.

source: He jumped off the stool and coldly said to the bartender, whose expression had remained grim.
target: Exsiliens e subsellio, frigidus ad cauponem dixit, cuius vultus severus manebat.

source: “Serving this kind of meat as steak to me? Get your boss out here!”
target: “Hancne carnem mihi ut ‘steak’ ministras? Educe dominum tuum huc!”

source: The bartender was taken aback.
target: Caupo stupefactus est.

source: “Are you certain?”
target: “Esne certus?”

source: He wasn’t embarrassed or angry at Lumian’s attitude; instead, there seemed to be a slight hint of pleasant surprise.
target: Non erubuit neque iratus est ob habitum Lumiani; potius, parva indicia iucundae admirationis apparebant.

source: Lumian didn’t answer but conveyed with his eyes that he wanted the boss to hurry up and come out.
target: Lumian non respondit; sed oculis intimavit se velle ut dominus celeriter exiret.

source: The bartender immediately shouted, “Boss! Boss! Someone’s about to wreck your bar!”
target: Caupo statim exclamat: “Domine! Domine! Aliquis paene tuam tabernam delebit!”

source: Within seconds, a figure rushed out from the kitchen.
target: Inter paucos secundos, figura ex culina festinanter exiit.

source: The figure had messy, fluffy hair and a very fat face, layered with flesh that made his eyes appear small, yet his body was quite standard, showing no sign of obesity.
target: Figura capillos inconditos et lanuginosos habebat, atque faciem valde obesam, carnis stratis inductam quae oculos eius parvos reddidit; sed corpus eius ordinarium, nullum adipositatis signum ostendens, erat.

source: At this moment, he was wearing a white apron and holding a cleaver, glaring angrily at the two customers near the bar, shouting in Lenburg, “Who? Who’s going to wreck my bar?”
target: In hoc momento, mappam albam gerebat et cultrum tenebat, iratus ad duos clientes prope tabernam aspexit, clamans in lingua Lenburg: “Quis? Quis tabernam meam delebit?”

source: Lumian pointed at the steak on the white porcelain plate and sneered, “You think I can’t tell what kind of meat this is?”
target: Lumian ad “steak” in albo plato porcellaneo digitum extulit et subsannavit: “Putasne me nescire qua genere carnis haec sint?”

source: “If I say it’s steak, it’s steak,” the fat-faced boss retorted without backing down.
target: “Si dicam id esse ‘steak’, id est ‘steak’”, respondit dominus obesus sine recedendo.

source: Lumian didn’t argue further. He took out a black glove from the Traveler’s Bag and tossed it in front of him.
target: Lumian amplius non contendit. Ex sacculo Viatoris manicam nigram extraxit et coram se proiecit.

source: “I challenge you to a duel,” Lumian said calmly.
target: «Te ad certamen provocabo», sedate inquit Lumian.

source: Throwing down a glove was a customary way to issue a duel challenge in Intis.
target: Manicam deponere erat more solito in Intis ad certamen provocandum.

source: The boss glanced at the black glove on the ground, his layers of fat shifting to reveal a light yellow beard.
target: Dominus in manicam nigrum in terra aspexit, et strata pinguedinis eius labente barbam luteam levem revelare coeperunt.

source: He was laughing.
target: Ridebat.

source: He responded to Lumian’s challenge, “Okay.”
target: Ad provocationem Lumiani respondit: “Bene.”

source: As soon as he spoke, he raised the cleaver and swung it down at Lumian.
target: Statim eum locuto, cultrum elevavit et contra Lumian deiecit.

source: Lumian sidestepped the blow, but suddenly felt he couldn’t use his teleportation ability.
target: Lumian ictum evitavit, sed repente sensit se facultatem teleportationis suae uti non posse.

source: The contract ability from the Abscessed Hand seemed to be stripped away by some strange power!
target: Facultas contracta ex “Abscessed Hand” videbatur ab aliqua potentia insolita sublata esse!

source: Lumian recalled Ludwig’s description of the Sequence 5 Depriver of the Gourmet pathway and suspected this boss-cum-chef was a blessed one of this pathway.
target: Lumian recordatus est descriptionem Ludovigi de “Sequence 5 Depriver” in via Gourmet, et suspicatus est hunc dominum cum coquus simul esse benedictum hujus itineris.

source: No wonder he can make Hand Bro’s rotten flesh look and smell like real steak…
target: Non mirum est quod potest effingere carnem putridam “Hand Bro” ita ut vera “steak” videatur et odor habeat…

source: A bestowed not executed but exiled to Morora?
target: Num concessus, non interfectus, sed in Mororam exsulatus?

source: Stop dumping all the trash in Morora…
target: Desine totum purgamentum in Mororam abicere…

source: Is it because they fear Morora’s population decline, risking the seal on 0-01?
target: Num quia timent declinationem populi Mororae, sigillum 0‑01 periclitantes?

source: As these thoughts flashed through his mind, Lumian swung his shoulder, his arm swelling, and punched out with his right fist.
target: Dum hae cogitationes in mente eius fulsirent, Lumian humerum suum volvens, brachiumque eius inflatum, dextro pugnus percussit.

source: His fist burst into bright, blazing-white flames, like a peacock’s tail, heading straight for the bartender.
target: Pugnus eius in nitidissimas flammas albas, quasi cauda pavonis, eruptus est, recta via ad cauponem tendens.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: As his fist struck the side of the heavy cleaver, a violent explosion occurred.
target: Cum pugnus eius latera cultri gravis percussit, violenta explosio evenit.

source: The blazing-white light lit up the entire bar, the violent blast overturning nearby stools and throwing the fat-faced boss away.
target: Lux flammea albae fulgentis totam tabernam illuminavit, dum explosio violenta subsellia proxima subvertebat et dominum obesum proiciebat.

source: Albus reacted quickly, jumping off his stool and perching on the bar counter far from the blast area.
target: Albus celeriter reactus, subsellium exiluit et in mensa tabernae longe ab area explosionis insedit.

source: He pulled one foot up, resting it on the bar, watching Lumian’s duel with interest.
target: Pedem unam levavit, eam in mensa collocans, et certamen Lumiani studio observabat.

source: The bartender was also caught in the blast, thrown against the liquor shelf, doused in the fragrant liquid from shattered bottles.
target: Caupo quoque in explosione comprehensus est, in scrinium liquoris proiectus, et in liquore aromatico ex poculis confractis demersus est.

source: He was nearly set on fire.
target: Paene ignibus incensus erat.

source: The bar owner, who took the brunt of the explosion, had his chest clothes torn, revealing blood, charred flesh, and white bones.
target: Dominus tabernae, qui ictum explosionis passus est, vestimenta pectoralia scissa habebat, sanguinem, carnes ustulatas, et ossa alba patefacientia.

source: His face had similar wounds, but the layers of fat kept it from affecting his skull.
target: Vultus eius vulnera similia habebat, sed strata pinguedinis cranium eius immuniter protegērunt.

source: The wounds were writhing and healing rapidly in an unnatural, inhuman way, as if they would soon be completely healed.
target: Vulnera contorquebantur et celeriter, modo innaturali atque inumano, sanabantur, quasi mox omnino convalescerent.

source: This isn’t a power or trait typical of a Depriver.
target: Haec non est vis aut proprietas typica Depriveris.

source: None of the middle or low Sequences in the Gourmet pathway have this ability.
target: Nulla ex sequentiis mediis aut inferioribus in via Gourmet hanc facultatem possidet.

source: Did he gain this from a special kind of food as a Chef?
target: Num hoc ex genere cibi speciali ut coquus adeptus est?

source: It’s similar to how Hand Bro’s rotten flesh can regenerate after being eaten…
target: Simile est modum quo caro putrida “Hand Bro” post consumptionem regenerari potest…

source: Lumian retreated a few steps from the bar owner, putting distance between them.
target: Lumian paucos passus a domino tabernae se recepit et distantiam inter eos constituit.

source: As he noticed the other party’s peculiarity, he also realized he had lost another ability—Spell of Harrumph.
target: Observans peculiarity alterius partis, etiam cognovit se aliam facultatem—Incantationem “Harrumph”—amissurum esse.

source: Can a Depriver sense which of my abilities and traits are most dangerous to them?
target: Num Depriver sentire potest quae ex meis facultatibus et proprietatibus illis maxime periculosa sint?

source: Even if they don’t know exactly what those abilities and traits are, can they still deprive me of them based on the level of danger they pose?
target: Etiamsi non exacte sciant quae sint illae facultates et proprietates, possuntne tamen me ab eis privare, ratione periculi quod ipsis incumbit?

source: Lumian calmly formed a massive, blazing-white fireball and shot it at the bar owner.
target: Lumian sedate ingentem globum ignis albi fulgentis condidit et ad dominum tabernae proiecit.

source: The bar owner didn’t dodge.
target: Dominus tabernae non evitavit.

source: He raised his nearly shattered cleaver and slashed at the blazing-white fireball.
target: Cultrum fere fractum elevavit et globum ignis albi fulgentis secuit.

source: The fireball split in two, losing its momentum and destructive aura.
target: Globus ignis in duas partes divisus est, momentum eius atque auram destructivam amittens.

source: The bar owner opened his mouth wide and sucked it in like a whale swallowing water, remaining unharmed.
target: Dominus tabernae os latius aperuit et illud, sicut cetus aquam vorans, aspiravit, intactus manens.

source: At that moment, Lumian laughed.
target: Illo momento, Lumian ridebat.

source: More blazing-white fireballs rapidly formed around him, whistling through the air toward the bar owner.
target: Plura globi ignis albi fulgentis celeriter circa eum coalescebant, per aerem sibilantes ad dominum tabernae volitantes.

source: Behind him, blazing-white Fire Ravens appeared one after another, flying in wide arcs to flank the bar owner.
target: Post eum, corvi ignis albi fulgentis, qui frontem conscie vitaverant, uno post alium apparuerunt, lati curvis volitantes ut dominum tabernae circumvenirent.

source: Lumian wanted to see how many fireballs the Depriver could handle and if he could eat them all without getting overwhelmed.
target: Lumian videre cupiebat quot globos ignis Depriver sustinere posset et an eos omnes edere sine overpoweratione valeat.

source: The bar owner’s eyes narrowed, and he immediately spewed the blazing-white flames from his stomach, transforming them into a torrent to meet the incoming fireballs.
target: Oculi domini tabernae contrarietate contracti sunt, et statim flammas albas fulgentes ex ventre eructavit, eas in torrentes convertens ad globos ignis advenientes oppugnandos.

source: Seeing this, Albus flipped over the bar counter.
target: Videns hoc, Albus super mensam tabernae transiluit.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: The fireballs exploded one after another upon contact with the flames.
target: Globi ignis, uno post alium cum flammas attigerunt, explosi sunt.

source: The counter was flattened, the liquor shelves collapsed silently, and the mixed liquor burned in a fierce blaze.
target: Mensa plana facta est, scrinia liquoris silentio corruerunt, et mixtus liquor in igne feroci combusus est.

source: The bartender, who had escaped to Albus’s position, felt very fortunate he had reacted in time.
target: Caupo, qui ad locum Albi effugit, se valde fortunatum sensit ob tempestivum suum reactum.

source: Other patrons either shrank to the edges of the room or escaped the hall, showing a wealth of experience.
target: Alii clientes aut ad limina conclavis coegerunt aut ex aula effugerunt, abundantiam experientiae ostendentes.

source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! The blazing-white Fire Ravens, which had deliberately avoided the front, fell on the bar owner’s back one after another.
target: “Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!”

source: By then, the bar owner was covered in a semi‑transparent crimson glow, like solidified moonlight.
target: Iam dominus tabernae semi‑transparente rubro splendore tegebatur, quasi lumen lunae solidatum.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: Despite the explosions and flames from the Fire Ravens, the bar owner’s crimson glow didn’t dim.
target: Non obstante explosionibus et ignibus a Corvis Ignis, ruber fulgor domini tabernae non obscuratus est.

source: Instead, it brightened with the fire’s reflection.
target: Immo, reflexione ignis, fulgore augebarat.

source: When the flames finally subsided, the bar owner returned to his normal appearance.
target: Quum flammas denique cessaverunt, dominus tabernae ad aspectum suum normalem rediit.

source: He lifted his cleaver and looked at where Lumian had been standing.
target: Cultrum suum sublevavit et intuens locum ubi Lumian steterat, aspexit.

source: No one was there.
target: Nemo aderat.

source: Lumian was nowhere to be seen in the hall either.
target: Lumian quoque in aula nusquam apparebat.

source: The bar owner was momentarily stunned.
target: Dominus tabernae per momentum obstupefactus erat.

source: Almost simultaneously, a figure emerged from his shadow.
target: Fere simul, figura e umbra eius emersit.

source: Lumian, his eyes iron‑black, struck the bar owner’s crotch with his blazing‑white flame‑covered right fist.
target: Lumian, oculis nigrosis ut ferro, inguen domini tabernae cum dextro pugnus igni albo tecto percussit.

source: Amid the rumbling, Lumian’s fist hit its mark, penetrating the Depriver’s intestines with blazing‑white flames.
target: Inter strepitum, pugnus Lumiani scopum attingit, intestina Depriver ignibus albis fulgentibus penetralia pertransiens.

source: Standing up straight, Lumian lifted the bar owner, letting the flames surge into his stomach.
target: Stans rectus, Lumian dominum tabernae elevavit, flammas in ventrem eius intransire siniens.

source: Then, Lumian withdrew his right fist and threw the bar owner to the ground.
target: Deinde, Lumian dextro pugnus abstulit et dominum tabernae in terram deiecit.

source: With a thud, the bar owner’s crotch split open, intestines spilling out, and his stomach, though intact, was scorched and oozing yellow‑green fluid.
target: Cum strepitu, inguen domini tabernae ruptus est, intestina erant effusa, et ventrem eius, quamquam intactum, combustum ac liquorem flavus‑viridem stillantem exhibebat.

source: Lumian looked at the bar owner’s pained, shrunken eyes and mocked, “Did you turn your brain into food too? You blocked one round of attacks, then stayed in the same spot without moving. Did you not consider that I might use your shadow?”
target: Lumian oculos domini tabernae, plenos doloris et contractos, intuens deriso inquit: “Num etiam cerebrum tuum in escam convertere fecisti? Unam seriem ictuum opprimes, deinde in eodem loco sine motu manes. Nonne putasti me umbram tuam uti posse?”

source: The bar owner’s face twisted as he murmured, “Turning… my own… brain into… food… Is it possible?”
target: Vultus domini tabernae contortus est, dum submurmurabat: “Convertens… meum ipsum… cerebrum in… escam… Num id fieri potest?”

source: His voice faded, and he died, lying motionless on the ground.
target: Vox eius evanuit, et mortuus est, in terra immotus iacens.

source: Lumian stared at the Depriver’s corpse, not thinking about his opponent’s response, but noting something unusual about the battle.
target: Lumian cadaver Depriveris contemplatus est, nullam de responsione adversarii cogitans, sed aliquid insolitum de pugna notans.

source: Deprivers sure have a variety of abilities. Though each one is basic and crude, their combat applications are quite formidable…
target: Depriver scilicet varietatem facultatum habent. Etsi singula fundamentalia atque rudia sint, applicationes eorum in pugna valde formidabiles apparent…

source: If this guy hadn’t reacted so sluggishly after I vanished, I wouldn’t have attacked his weak spot so easily. I might have needed to use one of the mystical items from the Traveler’s Bag…
target: Si hic vir non tam lententer post evanescens meam reagisset, non tam facile locum infirmum eius oppugnavissem; forsitan unum ex rebus mysticis Sacculi Viatoris adhibere necesse habuissem.

source: In comparison, Worms the Marauder didn’t have this problem…
target: Comparato, Worms the Marauder hanc difficultatem non habuit…

source: As he thought, Lumian shook his hand, revealing painful corrosive wounds caused by the stomach acid of the bar owner when he delivered the strike at his stomach.
target: Dum hoc cogitabat, Lumian manum suam concussit, revelans vulnera corrosiva et dolosa, quae acido ventris domini tabernae, cum ictum ad ventrem perferret, causa fuerunt.

source: His hand had been protected by the blazing‑white flames at the time.
target: Manus eius tempore a flammis albis fulgentibus protepta erat.

source: Despite knowing he couldn’t prevent the bar owner’s boons from returning to their source, Lumian squatted down, pulled a plain sword from the Traveler’s Bag, and used his flames to separate the stomach from the corpse.
target: Quamvis sciret se non posse impedire beneficia domini tabernae ad suam originem redire, Lumian se genu flectens sistit, gladium simplicem ex Sacculo Viatoris extraxit, atque flammas ad ventrem a cadavere dividendum usus est.

source: He planned to ask Ludwig if this could be made into a dish with special effects or if it could be used as a unique material by an Artisan.
target: Cogitavit Ludovigum interrogaturum, num hoc in ferculum cum effectibus specialibus converteri possit aut ut materia singularis a Artifice adhiberi valeat.

source: Finished with this task, Lumian stood and asked the bartender, who had just emerged from hiding and was severely injured, “How many years has your boss been exiled in Morora?”
target: Negotio hoc confecto, Lumian se levavit et cauponem, qui modo e latentibus effugit et graviter vulneratus erat, interrogavit: “Quot annos dominus tuus in Morora exsulatus est?”

source: “Five or six years, I think,” the bartender answered with an uncertain look.
target: «Quinque aut sex annos, credo», respondit caupo vultu incerto.

source: Five or six years… That thief looked younger, probably only exiled for a year or two… The longer one stays in Morora, the more likely they are to show symptoms of experimental personnel—symptoms of 0‑01 corruption. No, the sealing information didn’t mention this, and it doesn’t happen in Trier… Did the bar owner do something in Morora that caused him to start turning into an experimental subject?
target: Quinque aut sex annos… Ille fur juvenior videbatur, verisimiliter tantum per annum aut biennium exsulatus… Quo diutius quis in Morora manet, eo verisimilius symptomata personalia experimentalia—symptomata corruptionis 0‑01—ostendit. Non, nota sigillantis hoc non commemoravit, nec hoc in Trier evenit… Fecitne dominus tabernae quid in Morora, quod eum ad subiectum experimentale mutandum impulit?

source: Lumian pondered as he looked around and smiled. “Don’t take my spoils.”
target: Lumian circa se perspiciens et subridens meditatus est: “Noli spolia mea auferre.”

source: He referred to the bar owner’s money.
target: Referebat ad pecuniam domini tabernae.

source: Lumian then walked towards the corridor beside the bar.
target: Lumian deinde ad corridorium iuxta tabernam ambulavit.

source: Based on the origin of the “steak” and the Chef’s position, he suspected the Abscessed Hand’s body part was in the kitchen.
target: Ex origine “steak” et ex positione Coqui, suspicatus est partem corporis “Abscessed Hand” in culina esse.

source: Entering the kitchen, he saw a half‑decayed, swollen, blue‑black corpse openly displayed on the cooking counter.
target: Culina intrans, vidit cadaver semi‑putrescens, tumidum, caeruleo‑nigrum, palam in mensa coquinaria expositum.
